scope: checksum-verification amendment to the source-only portion; acceptance item 3 (hosted Storage HTTP proof) remains open and the issue stays In Progress
mechanism: the client declares the file MD5 (src/lib/operations/md5.ts, dependency-free, verified against Node crypto); the database verifies it against the Storage-computed object eTag at mark-uploaded and again at finalization; a mismatch or a changed object (id, owner, eTag, version when recorded, size, type) moves the row to failed durably in the same transaction and returns it; an eTag that is not a plain MD5 leaves the row uploaded and unverified and finalization refuses; nothing finalizes without checksum_verified (CHECK)
trust_precondition: the eTag is client-unwritable only while storage.objects is reachable solely through the Storage service; the storage schema must not be an API-exposed schema (hosted proof step 0 confirms public, graphql_public)
